online.structure: {id:string(uuid), timestamp:string(iso8601), parentId:string|null, agentId?:string, ephemeral?:boolean, type:string, data:object}
online.lodIdea: The single most direct LOD control found in any source this session: every copilot-sdk event carries ephemeral:true (or absent=false). Ephemeral events (deltas, progress, session.idle, elicitation/user_input/permission... see per-event notes) stream live but are never written to the session log and are NOT replayed on resume; persisted events are durable and replayable. parentId chains only persisted events together.
online.caveat: Public API (official copilot-sdk docs page). Per-event ephemeral/persisted status given in the per-event notes below is as documented on this page; not cross-checked against generated SDK source.

online.structure: IToolResult:{content:(IToolResultPromptTsxPart|IToolResultTextPart|IToolResultDataPart)[],toolSpecificData?,toolResultMessage?,toolResultDetails?:IToolResultInputOutputDetails|IToolResultOutputDetails,toolResultError?,toolMetadata?,confirmResults?}; IToolResultTextPart:{kind:'text',value,audience?,title?}; IToolResultDataPart:{kind:'data',value:{mimeType,data:VSBuffer},audience?,title?}; IToolResultInputOutputDetails:{input,inputLanguage?,output,isError?,mcpOutput?}
online.lodIdea: Internal result-side content union has only 3 kinds -- promptTsx (opaque prompt-element JSON, re-stringified for accessibility), text (value:string, optional audience?/title?), data (mimeType+VSBuffer, optional audience?/title?) -- narrower than and differently shaped from the public MCP 5-type content union (text/image/audio/resource/resource_link, S1): image/audio/binary are all folded into kind:data generically by mimeType rather than given distinct kinds. Separately, toolResultDetails.mcpOutput is explicitly 'Raw MCP tool result for MCP App UI rendering' -- i.e. the raw upstream MCP CallToolResult is preserved verbatim alongside the lossier internal 3-kind summary, a documented full-fidelity escape hatch.
online.caveat: INFERRED INTERNAL SOURCE -- workbench-internal, not public API. LanguageModelPartAudience (the audience? type) was previously NAME-ONLY (T-gap); its referenced use here is additional but still not a full definition read.

hints.name: assistant.usage (per-API-call usage/cost, ephemeral)
hints.lodIdea: Rich, fully field-level public usage schema distinct from, and more granular than, the session-aggregate T52 events: per-call inputTokens/outputTokens/reasoningTokens (subset of outputTokens)/cacheReadTokens/cacheWriteTokens, cost (billing multiplier), duration, timeToFirstTokenMs/interTokenLatencyMs (streaming perf), reasoningEffort, apiEndpoint (incl. distinguishing /chat/completions vs /v1/messages vs /responses vs ws:/responses vs /interactions), quotaSnapshots and copilotUsage (itemized provider cost breakdown), contentFilterTriggered/finishReason.
hints.caveat: Public API. Marked Ephemeral.; resolves prior T40 gap (per-call usage fields) at the CLI/SDK layer -- VS Code's own ChatResult usage shape remains separately unverified.

No separate dedicated memory.* event family (e.g. memory.created/memory.retired) was found in this pass -- the approval-flow event is the only memory-adjacent schema documented here. Other kinds (shell/write/read/mcp/url/custom-tool) are the general tool/file/network approval LOD gate; result.kind has 5 named outcomes incl. distinct denied-by-rules vs denied-interactively-by-user vs denied-by-content-exclusion-policy.

hints.name: Session lifecycle: idle/compaction/usage_info vs usage_checkpoint/shutdown
